meta.description: Deploy your commerce apps in seconds. BelloCloud runs BelloCommerce and more on managed, subscription-based infrastructure.
about.title: Building the infrastructure for modern commerce
about.p1: Our mission is to make powerful commerce software accessible to every merchant: managed, secure, and always online.
about.p2: BelloCloud runs commerce applications on managed, subscription-based infrastructure, so businesses can deploy in seconds and focus on selling, not servers.
about.p3: BelloCloud is the company behind BelloCommerce.
hero.title: The Commerce Infrastructure
hero.subtitle: Deploy your commerce apps in seconds. Pick an app, choose a plan, and BelloCloud runs it for you: managed, secure, and always on.
products.title: One-click commerce apps
products.subtitle: Subscription-based apps, deployed and managed for you on BelloCloud.
products.desc: The all-in-one commerce platform: storefront, point of sale, WhatsApp CRM, order confirmation, and shipping, all running on managed BelloCloud infrastructure from day one.
products.soon.title: More apps coming soon
products.soon.desc: The BelloCloud marketplace is growing. New subscription apps for your business are on the way.
features.title: Everything your apps need to run
features.subtitle: Infrastructure, billing, and team management, all handled for you.
features.deploy.desc: Pick an app, choose a plan, and it goes live on managed infrastructure. No servers to set up, ever.
features.managed.desc: Updates, backups, and monitoring handled for you. Your apps stay fast, secure, and always on.
features.teams.desc: Create organizations, invite your team, and control exactly who can do what with fine-grained permissions.
features.subs.desc: Transparent monthly plans. Manage, upgrade, or cancel your subscriptions anytime from the dashboard.
features.pay.desc: Pay with PayPal, top up your balance, and track every invoice from one billing page.
features.control.desc: Deploy, edit, or remove your apps whenever you want. Everything is a click away in your dashboard.
how.title: Live in three steps
how.s1.desc: Sign up in a minute, confirm your email, and set up your organization.
how.s2.desc: Choose BelloCommerce from the marketplace and the subscription that fits.
how.s3.desc: Your app is live in seconds. Invite your team and manage everything from one dashboard.
cta.title: Deploy your first app today
cta.subtitle: Sign up, pick BelloCommerce, and go live in seconds.
